messages:
Maya R: quick sync — onboarding mptx-65b-v2 weights + tokenizer quirks before quant. weights are at s3://redwood-models/mptx-65b/v2/final/ (sha256: abc123def456...). tokenizer: variant BPE, pad_id=1, legacy eos token id=50256. we've seen off-by-one in chunking during streaming; please confirm.

Alex T: grabbing weights now, will validate checksums. Any specific config we should use for calibration?

Maya R: calib dataset is in gs://redwood-calib/mptx-65b-v2/100k-samples/ — sampling strat: 80% prompts, 20% long-context. config snippet: 

```
{"quant_mode":"awq","bits":4,"group_size":128,"calib_samples":10000}
```

Samir K: runtime notes: AWQ path available on dedicated nodes; GPTQ path needs custom kernels (not prod-ready), FP8 still experimental on latest driver. prefer AWQ as default unless Jin flags accuracy regressions.

Jin L: running initial pass now. Early numbers: AWQ 4-bit ~ +1.9% delta on ppl vs fp16, GPTQ 4-bit +0.8% but slower decode. Need more evals on instruction-following sets. Will push CSV to /home/jin/calib_results/mptx-65b-v2/ by EOD.

Priya S: can we get a canary rollout plan? want route: hosted->dedicated->private, 2%->10%->100% over 24h with automatic fallback to fp16 if error rate >1%.

Alex T: ACK on canary. also note tokenizer: pad_id collision with control tokens in older tokenizers; i'll run tokenizer unit tests (tokenizer_tests/mptx_v2/*.py).

Maya R: request approvals: @product please signoff on accuracy tradeoff; @security confirm weights location access controls; @eng-sre confirm canary policy.

Ethan P: reviewed initial evals, rough ok with AWQ if Jin's FT tests pass. +1 pending final numbers.

Grace H: checked S3 ACLs and KMS policies, looks good. one wildcard in a staging bucket to fix before public rollout. :thumbsup: 

Priya S: Canary policy created in console -> rollout id r-2026-03-mptx. monitoring config: p95 latency, error_rate, token_rt. alert thresholds: p95>500ms increase or error_rate>1%.

Jin L: pushed results: /home/jin/calib_results/mptx-65b-v2/awq-vs-gptq.csv — summary: AWQ 4-bit drops instruction-acc by ~0.6% vs fp16 but latency improves ~35%. GPTQ keeps instr-acc closer but adds decode overhead. attaching quick notes in the CSV.

Maya R: consensus leaning AWQ for hosted + optional GPTQ for Dedicated. anyone blocking?

Alex T: no blockers from infra once tokenizer unit tests pass and checksum validated.

Samir K: runtime fallback config suggestion:

```
fallback:
  - model_variant: mptx-65b-v2-gptq
    criteria: latency>700ms
  - model_variant: mptx-65b-v2-fp16
    criteria: error_rate>1%
```

Maya R: thanks — i'll schedule the rollout tomorrow morning and watch first canary window. closing thread after final CI green.

Ethan P: thx, ping me when canary hits 10% :eyes:
